about: Published US seller fees for the Thriftaholics app. Update this file when a marketplace changes its fees; every device picks it up from Platforms → Check for fee updates.

poshmark.name: Poshmark
poshmark.notes: Flat $2.95 on sales under $15; 20% on $15 and up, on the sale price only. No separate processing fee. The buyer pays the prepaid USPS label ($6.49, up to 5 lb). You pay the upgrade for heavier boxes (+$5 for 5–10 lb, +$10 for 10–15 lb) and any shipping discount you offer — enter those under “My extra shipping cost”.

depop.name: Depop
depop.notes: US: no selling fee. Payment processing 3.3% + $0.45 on the full order (item + shipping + tax). Boosted listings cost 12% of a boosted sale — add it under Additional costs if you boost. Buyers pay a separate marketplace fee that doesn’t come out of your payout.

ebay.name: eBay
ebay.notes: Most categories incl. clothing, shoes & accessories, no Store: 13.6% of the order total (item + shipping + tax) up to $7,500 (2.35% above), plus $0.40 per order ($0.30 on orders of $10 or less). Processing is included. Athletic sneakers $150+: 8% with no per-order fee. 250 free listings a month, then $0.35 each. Store plans and some categories differ.

mercari.name: Mercari
mercari.notes: 10% selling fee on the item price + the shipping the buyer pays. No seller processing fee. Buyers pay a separate buyer-protection fee. Instant Pay cash-outs cost $3 (standard direct deposit is free).

facebook marketplace.name: Facebook Marketplace
facebook marketplace.notes: Shipped (checkout) orders: 10% of the order total, minimum $0.80; processing is included. Local pickup paid in person is free — create a separate “Facebook local” platform with 0% if you sell both ways.

vinted.name: Vinted
vinted.notes: No seller fees in the US — you keep the full item price. The buyer pays the Vinted fee (about 5% + $0.70) and the shipping label. Optional Bumps / Closet spotlight are paid promotions.

amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.notes: Clothing & Accessories referral fee: 5% if the total (item + shipping you charge) is $15 or less, 10% from $15 to $20, 17% above $20; $0.30 minimum. Processing is included. Individual plan: +$0.99 per item sold. Professional plan: $39.99/month instead — delete the $0.99 cost and add $39.99 per month. Most other categories are 15%. FBA fulfillment and storage fees are extra.

etsy.name: Etsy
etsy.notes: US: $0.20 to list (renews every 4 months or when it sells), 6.5% transaction fee on item + shipping + gift wrap, and payment processing of 3% + $0.25 on the order total. Offsite Ads add 15% (12% if you sold $10k+ in the last year) on sales they bring in. Items must be vintage (20+ years), handmade or craft supplies.

grailed.name: Grailed
grailed.notes: Commission: 6% (minimum $1.99) on sales under $120, 9% from $120 (since May 20, 2026). With a Grailed label the commission is on the item price only. Payment processing 3.49% + $0.49 on the total incl. shipping (4.99% + $0.49 for international buyers).

whatnot.name: Whatnot
whatnot.notes: Commission 8% of the item’s final price (not shipping) for sellers under $15k in the last 4 weeks; bigger sellers pay less, coins 4%. Payment processing 2.9% + $0.30 on the whole order incl. shipping and tax. No listing fees.

tiktok shop.name: TikTok Shop
tiktok shop.notes: US referral fee 6% for most categories (5% for some jewelry and pre-owned) on what the buyer pays + platform discounts, excluding tax and shipping; processing is included. Several seller sources report 8% since Aug 4, 2026 — check the rate in Seller Center. Affiliate creator commissions (often 10–20%) are extra; add one under Additional costs if you use them.

vestiaire collective.name: Vestiaire Collective
vestiaire collective.notes: US, items listed from Oct 15, 2026: under $75 a flat $12 selling fee + $3 processing; $75–$15,000: 17% + 3% processing (over $15,000: flat $2,500 + 3%). Minimum price $18. Each listing keeps the fee in force when you listed it.

the realreal.name: The RealReal
the realreal.notes: Consignment — they price, photograph and ship it. Fee shown is what TRR keeps, based on its published clothing schedule (you earn 20% under $100, 30% $100–149, 45% $150–199, 55% $200–299, 60% $300–749). Rates vary by category and RealReal Rewards tier; promos change them. Check your consignor agreement and edit.

stockx.name: StockX
stockx.notes: Verified Marketplace, Seller Level 1: 9% transaction fee + 3% payment processing on the sale price (Level 2 8.5%, 3 8%, 4 7.5%, 5 7%). US sellers pay a $5 shipping fee per sale. New, unworn items only.

offerup.name: OfferUp
offerup.notes: Local pickup only — OfferUp ended nationwide shipping on Sept 23, 2025, so there are no selling fees. Collect payment at the meetup. Optional paid promotions.

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.notes: Your own online store. Basic plan $39/month ($29 paid yearly). Shopify Payments: 2.9% + $0.30 per online card sale (3.5% for premium cards, +1% international). Using another payment provider adds 2%.
